newsitem.title: USA: Hawaiian Airlines in deal with Eagle.
newsitem.headline: Hawaiian Airlines in deal with Eagle.

text.p: Hawaiian Airlines Inc said Thursday it signed a cooperative marketing "code share"

agreement with American Eagle carrier Wings West Airlines Inc. to provide connecting service to Hawaiian's West Cost-Hawaii gateways in Los Angeles from 10 cities in California and Nevada, starting March 4.
It is expected that the new service will be available for booking in worldwide computer reservations systems starting February 23, 1997.

Under the new agreement, American Eagle/Wings West will provide direct connections to Hawaiian's Los Angeles operation from San Diego, Orange County, Santa Barbara, Palm Springs, Monterey, San Luis Obispo, Fresno, Bakersfield, Carlsbad and Las Vegas.
